text: On 23 March 2023 Calvin and Dave caught up after not talking for a while, and Dave said he had recently attended an event that was a car lover's paradise with many classic cars on show.
Dave said that at the classic car event he spoke with several owners of the cars and heard their fascinating stories, which Dave found super inspiring and motivating.
Calvin told Dave on 23 March 2023 that something really exciting had happened, a big life change, and shared a photo of a building with a sign on the front, described as Calvin's new mansion.
Dave congratulated Calvin on the big life change in the session dated 23 March 2023 and asked what had inspired Calvin to start this journey.
Calvin said on 23 March 2023 that Calvin was excited to learn about Japanese culture and to get a chance to expand, and that Calvin had never been to Japan but was fascinated by its traditions.
Calvin said Calvin was heading to Japan next month, meaning April 2023, and would be staying in a nice place while there, a photo of a living room with a couch, table and television.
Calvin said Calvin's agent had found Calvin an awesome place to stay in Japan, and Calvin was very thankful for the arrangement made for the April 2023 trip.
Calvin planned to explore the city in Japan, try out different local cuisines and perhaps collaborate with musicians in the area during the trip starting in April 2023.
Calvin said Calvin would be in Japan for a few months and then travel on to Boston, and said Calvin could not wait for the trip to begin.
Dave said on 23 March 2023 that Dave had been spending lots of time lately at a beautiful and calming park with a lake and a few boats, and asked whether Calvin had been to that park before.
Calvin said Calvin had never been to that park, thought it looked like a chill spot, and planned to check it out after returning from Japan, thanking Dave for the tip.
Dave offered to give Calvin more recommendations if needed and wished Calvin a fun trip, and Calvin said Calvin would let Dave know if Calvin needed any help during the trip.
On 26 March 2023 Calvin told Dave that Calvin had just got a new luxury car, a red sports car, and that owning a luxury car was a dream come true for Calvin.
Calvin said the new red sports car was a beauty that Calvin had taken for a ride the day before 26 March 2023, and that Calvin felt it was what Calvin deserved after all the hard work.
Calvin described the new car as super smooth and really powerful, like a rockstar behind the wheel, and said that every time Calvin steps in it feels like an adrenaline rush.
Dave congratulated Calvin on the new car, asked how it was driving, asked whether it was Calvin's first one and what it was called, and Calvin replied that Calvin had finally got this beauty.
Dave said that the weekend before 26 March 2023 Dave went to a music festival in Boston, which was awesome, with many cool bands playing and an electric atmosphere, and said Dave loves music.
Dave named Aerosmith as Dave's favourite band at the Boston music festival, said their performance was incredible, and said Dave finally saw them live, a dream for a fan of the band.
Dave said Dave did not get to hang out with the performers after the show but that seeing Dave's favourite band live was cool enough and a dream come true for any fan.
Calvin said Calvin had a new ride, had written some new tunes, and had studio sessions the week of 19 March 2023, and was excited to collaborate on the new music with others.
Calvin said Calvin would keep Dave updated on how the music collaborations went and said Calvin was excited to share the new songs with everyone, with Dave looking forward to hearing them.

On 20 April 2023 Calvin told Dave that Calvin had just attended a music festival in Tokyo, which was awesome, where Calvin saw no bands but met lots of talented artists and industry people and found it totally enriching.
Calvin said Calvin learned a lot at the Tokyo music festival and got great advice from professionals in the music industry, which Calvin found inspiring and motivating for Calvin's own career.

A music producer at the Tokyo festival advised Calvin to stay true to himself and sound unique, which got Calvin thinking about where Calvin wants the music to go, and Calvin said it was really motivating.
Calvin said Calvin dreams of touring the world, performing for different people and connecting with them, and hopes the music can reach a global audience and make an impact.
Calvin said Calvin was looking forward to a trip to Boston after finishing the Frank Ocean tour, because Calvin had heard the music scene in Boston is awesome and wanted to check it out.

Dave said the Boston music scene includes places such as Paradise Rock, House of Blues and Fenway Park, that Calvin would have great performances there, and offered to show Calvin around town and all the cool spots.
Dave said Dave would be in the front row when Calvin performed onstage in Boston, and Dave shared a photo of a city skyline with a boat in the water from Boston.

Dave said Dave went to a car show the weekend before 20 April 2023, that classic cars are charming, that the dedication people put into restoring them is amazing, and that this is why Dave is so into auto engineering.

Dave shared a photo of a green Mustang parked in a field of grass on 20 April 2023, and Calvin shared a photo of Calvin's own red sports car on display at a show, saying Calvin put a lot of work into it.

Calvin said Calvin had not yet explored Boston apart from the gigs because Calvin had been busy with rehearsals and traveling, but was looking forward to exploring the city, trying delicious food and visiting popular attractions.
Calvin and Dave agreed to grab food together when Calvin was in Boston, with Dave promising to show Calvin Dave's favourite spots in the city and both saying they could not wait.

On 1 May 2023 Dave told Calvin that Dave had finally opened Dave's own car maintenance shop, which Dave described as a dream come true and a spot to work on cars, and shared a photo of the dealership-style lot outside.

Dave said the car maintenance shop was a step towards Dave's other dream of working on classic cars, which Dave loves for their design and engineering, and said the shop was a lot of hard work but worth it.
Dave said Dave works on all kinds of cars at the shop, from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars, and that it keeps Dave busy and happy.
Dave said Dave was thrilled to restore a classic car in 2022, the year before 1 May 2023, and shared a photo of the engine of the restored car, which had a small air filter.
Dave described the car restoration as a labour of love that was challenging but so worth it, and said it felt great to see something worked on come back to life.
Dave invited Calvin to come by the shop sometime and shared a photo of a group of people standing in front of a car at the shop, which Dave called a photo of Dave's shop.
Calvin congratulated Dave on opening the car shop on 1 May 2023, said Dave has guts and ambition, and said Calvin would love to check out the shop sometime and asked what cars Dave works on.
Dave said that working on cars is what Dave is passionate about, and that helping people keep their cars in good condition and seeing the transformation is really satisfying and rewarding.
Calvin shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant on 1 May 2023 and said it was a gift from another artist, a great reminder of why Calvin keeps hustling as a musician.
Calvin said the road can be hard for a musician, but remembering why they do it keeps them going, and proposed that Calvin and Dave keep each other motivated while pursuing their dreams.
On 3 May 2023 Dave told Calvin that Dave was teaming up with a local garage and shared a photo of a car being worked on in a garage, describing it as crazy news.
Dave said on 3 May 2023 that Dave is loving the job, gets to work with awesome mechanics and shares Dave's knowledge about cars, and is currently working on a cool but challenging car project.
Dave said Dave would keep learning more about auto engineering and hoped to one day build a custom car from scratch, which Dave called the dream, while assisting customers in the meantime.
Calvin said long drives in Calvin's red sports car really help Calvin relax, with the feeling of the wind and the open road being freeing and helping Calvin clear Calvin's head.
Dave said that taking a walk around is a great way for Dave to destress, and that exploring and taking in the sights and sounds is a peaceful experience Dave enjoys.
Calvin said Calvin had been loving getting to know Japanese culture, but that Calvin was stuck with music at the moment, as Calvin's creativity felt frozen, and Calvin asked Dave for tips on it.

Dave advised that when having trouble coming up with ideas, immersing yourself in something you love, like concerts or favourite albums, usually jumpstarts inspiration, and suggested taking a break from music to explore other things.
Calvin said taking a break from music was great for getting Calvin's mojo back, and said Calvin would take Dave's advice and explore other things, thanking Dave for the help.
Calvin told Dave on 16 May 2023 that an incident the week before, the week of 8 May 2023, had left Calvin's place flooded, but Calvin managed to save Calvin's music gear and favourite microphone.

Calvin said Calvin was waiting on insurance to kick in before starting repairs to the flood damage, hoped it would not take too long, and was staying positive and looking forward to getting everything fixed up.
Calvin shared a photo of Calvin's music studio, described as a creative haven where Calvin pours Calvin's heart into music, with a keyboard, a synthesizer and other musical equipment.

Dave said Dave opened Dave's car shop last week, the week of 8 May 2023, and invited friends over to celebrate, which Dave described as incredible so far, though Dave had announced the shop on 1 May 2023.
Calvin said Calvin had an upcoming performance in Tokyo later in May 2023 and was excited to show Calvin's music to a whole new crowd and hopefully expand Calvin's following.
Calvin shared a photo of a city at night with a lot of lights, saying Calvin took it in Tokyo the night before, on 15 May 2023, and that the skyline was stunning.
Dave said Dave wants to visit Tokyo soon and added it to Dave's list after Calvin encouraged Dave to visit, saying the city lights there are amazing.
Calvin said Calvin would keep Dave posted on how the Tokyo show went, and Dave wished Calvin luck and said the Tokyo audience was going to love Calvin's performance.
On 31 May 2023 Calvin told Dave that touring with Frank Ocean the week before had been wild, and that the Tokyo show crowd was insane and made Calvin feel so alive when performing.
Calvin said the energy and love from the fans on the tour was crazy, and that Calvin found performing in Tokyo unreal, with feelings Calvin could not find the words to express.
Dave shared a photo of Dave working on a car engine in a garage on 31 May 2023, saying Dave had fixed up the engine of Dave's neighbour's car, which had been having trouble.
Dave said helping neighbours with their cars is not difficult, and that working on cars is definitely therapeutic for Dave, asking Calvin whether it relaxes Calvin as much as it relaxes Dave.
Calvin described fixing cars as calming, giving a real sense of achievement and feeling like meditation, and asked Dave whether Dave had hobbies that give the same satisfaction.

Dave described fixing up things as more than a hobby, giving a sense of achievement and purpose and a buzz from turning something not working into something that runs smoothly, like giving it a second chance.
Calvin said performing live always fuels Calvin's soul, bringing a rush and a connection with the crowd that Calvin described as an absolute high, with a feeling that is indescribable.
Dave said the connection between an artist and audience must be powerful, and shared a photo on 31 May 2023 of a large crowd of people taking pictures of a concert, described as off the charts.
Calvin said Calvin was buzzing to perform in Boston and see what it is like, and that playing for folks from home would be great, and asked Dave what Dave thought of the music scene there.
Dave said Boston's music scene is awesome with tons of talented musicians and cool places to play, and promised to be there in Boston to cheer Calvin on at the performance.
Calvin said Calvin was excited for the upcoming tour with Frank Ocean, and Dave asked what was next for Calvin's music, with both agreeing the Boston shows would be a blast.
On 9 June 2023 Calvin told Dave that Calvin had met the creative team for Calvin's album on 8 June 2023, a long session that was awesome to see everything coming together.
Calvin said Calvin was feeling stoked about the album, with a team in the studio working on the music and everything, and shared a photo of a recording studio with a large window and a desk.
Dave said Dave had been exploring parks on the weekends to relax, finding it so peaceful being surrounded by nature, and asked Calvin whether there were any chill spots Calvin enjoys in Boston.
Calvin said Calvin had never been to Boston before, had heard the parks there are amazing, and could not wait to visit Boston next month, meaning July 2023.
Dave said Dave went for a stroll in a Boston park on Friday 2 June 2023 and that it was amazing, and that Dave loves weekend walks because they recharge Dave for the entire upcoming week.

Calvin said Calvin had not been to the mountains but was keen to go, and wanted to go on a hike to a place similar to the snowy mountain range in the photo Calvin shared, to escape it all and de-stress.

Dave said Dave had not gone hiking recently, but that being in nature and pushing yourself to new heights clears the mind and brings a sense of calm, and asked whether Calvin had been to the mountains.
Dave said Dave had booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month, July 2023, and was excited to finally see the majestic peaks, calling it going to be an amazing experience.
Calvin asked Dave to take lots of pictures on the mountain trip and to show them to Calvin when Dave gets back, and Dave agreed to take lots of pics and show Calvin after the trip.

On 21 June 2023 Calvin told Dave that Calvin had a small car accident last Friday, 16 June 2023, which was upsetting but left no one hurt, and shared a photo of a red car with a black rim parked on a sidewalk.
Calvin said Calvin had been dealing with insurance and car repairs after the 16 June 2023 accident, which was taking up a lot of Calvin's time and energy.
Calvin said the insurance process was a hassle that took forever and involved a ton of paperwork, but it was all sorted out within a week, and Calvin shared a photo of a tow truck in a parking lot.
Calvin said Calvin had been worried about the repair cost, but it was not too bad, and that the car was being fixed up and Calvin was excited to drive it again.

Calvin described the mechanic at the auto repair shop as someone who knows the stuff and is doing the best to get Calvin's car running again, and said Calvin was trusting their expertise and feeling confident.
Calvin shared a view from the living room on 21 June 2023 of a small town in Japan with a mountain in the background, and said the view of the mountains there is unbelievably stunning.

Calvin said Calvin had not yet been to the small Japanese town with the mountain view, which is on Calvin's to-do list for after the Frank Ocean tour ends, and that Calvin can't wait to see the tour in person.
Calvin said Calvin had not tried skiing before, but it looked like a lot of fun from the snowy mountain photo Calvin shared, and that Calvin might give it a try once.
Dave said Dave had recently joined a rock band and had been practising guitar, and shared a photo of the band members playing instruments together in a room on 21 June 2023.
Calvin said playing guitar in a rock band is awesome and will bring Dave a lot of emotions, and Dave replied that good company and great music lift the mood and bring positive emotions.
On 7 July 2023 Dave asked Calvin how the car was doing after the crash, and Calvin replied that the car had been fixed and was going strong, with nothing better than cruising around in it.

Dave said Dave had been hanging out with friends at parks lately and had arranged regular walks together in the park with friends, a plan Calvin praised as a wonderful way to spend time and stay active.
Dave said the group was going to their favourite spot in the park that day and shared a photo of a city skyline with a river and boats in the water, taken on 7 July 2023.
Calvin described the sunset over the river as gorgeous and said the spot reminded Calvin of living in Calvin's Japanese mansion with its epic cityscape, which Calvin said felt like a dream come true.
Calvin shared a photo taken from the backyard of the Japanese mansion, showing a boat docked in a canal at sunset, and a photo of the front of the mansion with many windows and lights.
Calvin said that whenever Calvin looks out the windows of the mansion and sees the city lights, it is so awe-inspiring, and called the mansion luxury and beauty on a whole new level.
Dave said Dave had never been to Japan but was so keen to go one day, having heard it is full of vibes, good eats and awesome tech, and said Dave is hooked on Japanese music.

Calvin said Calvin can't wait to try the food and check out the culture in Japan, and said Calvin has been working on music collaborations with Japanese artists that Calvin is excited to hear come together.

Calvin said Calvin would share some clips of the Japanese artist collaborations once everything is ready, and that collaborating with various artists is always exciting as a chance to create something unique.

On 21 July 2023 Dave told Calvin that Dave had just got back from a road trip with friends, which showed stunning countryside, and that the winding roads and chatting with friends recharged Dave totally.
Dave said the road trip was a lovely break from the corporate mayhem and reminded Dave why Dave loves cars so much, and that the trip made the long hours at work worth it.
Dave shared a photo of a person riding a motorcycle down a dirt road from the road trip on 21 July 2023, describing it as a wonderful place the group had found on the trip.

Calvin said Calvin is working on a project to transform a Japanese mansion into a recording studio, a long-held dream of having a space for creating music with other artists, and shared a photo of the progress made.
Calvin described the mansion studio project as a sanctuary that reminds Calvin why Calvin loves music, and said having a space to work in feels great.

Calvin said Calvin had been experimenting with different genres lately, pushing Calvin's own comfort zone, and adding electronic elements to songs, which gives the songs a fresh vibe and is an exciting process of self-discovery.

Calvin said switching between styles can be tough and intimidating, but finding the right balance between Calvin's own sound and trying new things is what makes it exciting and keeps Calvin motivated.

Calvin said Calvin started making music to follow Calvin's dreams, and that collaborating with others, learning from them and surrounding Calvin with positive energy and passion keeps Calvin motivated under pressure.
Dave said finding a balance between styles is tricky but keeps things interesting, and asked Calvin how Calvin was dealing with the pressure and staying motivated.
Dave told Calvin to keep pushing towards goals and said Dave is Calvin's biggest fan, with both agreeing to chat again soon.

On 3 August 2023 Calvin told Dave that Calvin had just taken Calvin's Ferrari for a service, which was so stressful because Calvin is kind of attached to the car, and asked Dave what hobbies give a feeling of being restored.
Dave said fixing cars is like therapy for Dave, and that growing up working on cars with Dave's dad gave Dave a sense of fulfilment from refurbishing them.
Dave recalled that as a kid Dave spent one summer restoring an old car with Dave's dad, which was hard work but really satisfying to finish together and see the end result.
Dave shared a photo of a man and a child posing together from the time Dave worked on cars with Dave's dad, saying it was a wonderful experience.

Calvin said Calvin's Ferrari reminds Calvin of Calvin's hard work and dedication and inspires Calvin, and that Calvin had seen many amazing cars on a trip to the Ferrari dealership, though Calvin's own car is the best.
Calvin shared a photo on 3 August 2023 of a red car lifted on a lift in a garage, saying Calvin is pretty proud of this beauty and that seeing it every day keeps Calvin motivated.

Calvin said Calvin's plan is to expand Calvin's brand worldwide and grow Calvin's fanbase, so that Calvin's music reaches more people and makes an impact, along with working with artists from around the globe.
Calvin said Calvin performed with the boys, Calvin's band, the night before 3 August 2023, and shared a photo of the band playing on stage with lights on, saying they are great at the music.
Dave encouraged Calvin to stay focused, keep going and never forget Calvin's dreams, and Calvin replied that Calvin's determination to make dreams come true means a lot.

On 11 August 2023 Dave told Calvin that Dave had been picked for a car mod workshop, which is a dream come true because Dave has always wanted to learn auto engineering and work on building a custom car.

Dave shared a photo on 11 August 2023 of Dave standing in front of a car on a lift at the workshop, and a photo of a car being worked on by a mechanic, saying seeing the potential come to life is always satisfying.

Dave said Dave has been working on a classic muscle car, doing engine swaps and suspension modifications, and is now learning about body modifications to give the classic car a modern twist, which is a challenge but so fun.
Dave shared a photo of a silver Corvette parked in front of a building, saying Dave wanted a modern vibe while keeping the classic muscle car style and was really happy with the result.

Dave said small details make a car unique and personalised, and that customising it is like customising a work of art on wheels that shows Dave's style, which Dave described as a way of making it personal.

Dave offered to help Calvin with Calvin's music stuff and shared a photo of Dave's music studio setup with a keyboard, a monitor, a keyboard pad and a high-quality sound system, saying Calvin's songs would sound amazing there.
Calvin said Calvin is super busy with music at the moment, so Calvin would keep Dave's offer of studio help in mind, and Dave replied that Dave understood and wished Calvin good luck with the music.

On 14 August 2023 Dave told Calvin that Dave had recently attended a car workshop in San Francisco, where Dave dived into the world of car restoration and saw many different techniques, and found the people passionate and dedicated.

Calvin said Calvin had recently finished touring with a well-known artist, ending with a show in Japan, and that Calvin then had the opportunity to explore Calvin's new place in Japan, which was like a dream come true.
Calvin said the Tokyo show went awesome, with the crowd so into it that everyone sang along when Calvin played one of Calvin's songs, which Calvin called a magical moment.

Calvin shared a photo of a crowd with their hands up at a concert and said that moments like these are why Calvin loves Calvin's job, and that being in such a buzzing crowd makes Calvin proud and motivated.

Dave shared a photo of a beat-up car with a broken engine that Dave is restoring, and said the project is going great and that it is pretty cool seeing the car go from a beat-up mess to a real beauty.

Dave said Dave hoped the restored car would be all fixed up by the end of September 2023, with lots of elbow grease, but that it would be worth the transformation, and Calvin said Calvin was excited to see the end result.

On 22 August 2023 Dave told Calvin that last Friday, 18 August 2023, Dave had a card night with friends that was so much fun, and shared a photo of a group of men sitting at a table with playing cards.
Calvin said Calvin had scored a deal to continue collaboration with Frank Ocean on 22 August 2023, a dream come true after working hard, and said no words can describe how happy Calvin is.

Calvin said Calvin met Frank Ocean at a music festival in Tokyo, they clicked and have been speaking and sharing ideas, and Frank Ocean and Calvin arranged a meeting and recorded a song in the studio at Calvin's mansion.
Calvin said the Tokyo festival city was buzzing with energy and the festival crowd was lively, and that it was like fuel for Calvin's soul, with everyone feeling connected during the performance.

Calvin said someone noticed Calvin's performance at the Tokyo festival and that Calvin is now working together with that person, which Calvin found wild, and asked Dave whether Dave had any upcoming concerts to know about.
Calvin said Calvin's tour with Frank Ocean ends soon, after which Calvin is heading to Boston, and suggested that Calvin and Dave could meet up there when Calvin arrives.
Calvin said Calvin recorded a podcast with Calvin's friends on 21 August 2023 where they discuss the rapidly evolving rap industry, and that Calvin would let Dave know when the podcast is uploaded.
Dave said Dave was looking forward to hearing the podcast and learning more about the rap industry, and asked Calvin to fill Dave in on the details of the collaboration when Calvin has them.
